name: Tsukiro
loreTies: Source: Tsukuyomi (moon god, purification cycle, torii thresholds)
shortBackstory: Tsukiro is the moon-veil renewal — the Tsukuyomi-source whose purification comes through darkness. Some things can only be cleansed in shadow.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Tsukiro was born from the moon's passage — the cycle that purifies what the sun illuminates. He is the battery who renews through the dark half of the cycle. Ancient humans saw him as Tsukuyomi — but they saw the moon and missed the purification. Tsukiro's darkness is not absence; it is cleansing.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Tsukiro is the reason spirit energy cycles rather than stagnating. Amaterion illuminates; Tsukiro purifies. Without the dark half, the light would expose everything and cleanse nothing.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Tsukiro by making his purification meaningless. The Hollow removes things so completely there is nothing to purify. Purification of nothing is not cleansing; it is just darkness.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Kami Mirror Tempest, Tsukiro renews allied Deities through moon-veil purification. His moon-veil absorbs corruption and converts it to force. But the Hollow means some corruption is not corruption — it is simply gone.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Tsukiro's flaw is that he believes darkness is always healing. He has hidden things that should have been revealed. The Hollow teaches him that some darkness is not purification — it is just absence wearing the mask of cleansing.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
